new_results.statement: A symmetric hollow nonnegative defect matrix with every disjoint 2x2 minor zero has at most one nontrivial support component, which is a star or a clique.

In the balanced exact-rank-three clique endpoint, the clique factorizes F_ij=c_i c_j, has support size at most five, compresses product-preservingly to at most six independent scalars, and satisfies ||p_Q||inf<=24*sqrt(pi).
The bare three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not bound the factorized-clique support size: an explicit sign-balanced pair-PSD target-valid family has clique support n for arbitrary n.

rank_two_control: The opposite-sign rank-two product 2XY retains a logarithmic density singularity. In the new branch the third direction is the diagonal correction D; exact rank three localizes D and the projected-gradient proof changes the residual singular integral from one-dimensional 1/|t| to two-dimensional 1/|y-z|.
